comment: CANONICAL Strat config — single source of truth for Python backtests AND NT8 bots. Edit here, sync/deploy everywhere. NT8 reads this via StratConfig.cs (Strategies/Vinay/strat_config.json). Python reads via scripts.libs_py.the_strat.config.load_strat_config().

ftfc.comment: LONG needs score >= +min_score, SHORT needs score <= -min_score. Score = bull_TFs - bear_TFs over ftfc_timeframes.

session.comment: When use_killzones=true only entries inside a killzone are taken. flatten_by is a hard exit (ADR-020: no position past 16:00 ET).

risk.comment: Targets use measured-move engine (targets.py): entry +/- max(inside_range, prior_leg_frac, min_target_points). max_risk_points caps the structural stop; tighter structural stops are kept, wider ones are capped (and flagged).

execution.comment: confirm_next_bar=true means the trigger bar must close as the setup type AND the next bar must break the trigger level (no lookahead fills).
